overview_description.description: RonanRx provides a health technology platform for doctor-led, patient-specific medicine. Its software supports patient intake, records, scheduling, payments, doctor review, pharmacy workflows, patient communication, shipping coordination, and refill continuity. RonanRx also supports personalized GLP-1 care in which a physician determines the prescription and a selected pharmacy reviews, prepares, and dispenses medication. The platform does not prescribe or operate as a pharmacy.
